author: OpenAxolotl project; original composition and arrangement authored with Codex
tool: Python, NumPy, SciPy and libsndfile; offline multisample arrangement
prompt: Make the existing hip-hop background music more poppy and upbeat, with a brighter hook and punchier rhythm, while retaining moderate speed, quiet gameplay playback and a separate shuffle song.
licenseTerms: Original arrangement under the project Apache-2.0 license. Underlying recordings: VSCO 2 Community Edition and VCSL by Versilian Studios, both CC0-1.0. VSCO recordings by Sam Gossner and Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler/Soundemote. See both pinned manifests and licenses in the source folder.
description: Quiet Currents, bright pop groove: 48 bars, 104 BPM, D major, 110.769 seconds. Near-straight drums, snappy layered snare, octave bass, short piano chords and a repeating bright piano/marimba hook. Less swing, shorter releases and less reverb than the hip-hop version. No flute or vocals.
